notes.title: Transporter 1.0 Full Release is out now !
notes.notes:
Welcome to Transporter 1.0!

Transporter is a platformer racing game.

Choose among 3 types of vehicles: Classic, Amphibious and Military. 

Your goal is to preserve your goods, maintain balance, and overcome obstacles with at least one item left at the finish line.


[hr][/hr]Launche & Sale
Full release date: Wednesday, June 18, 2025 

Launch-week discount: 33% off from June 18 to July 17, 2025

Visit our Steam page to download the full release of Transporter


[hr][/hr]


Thank you to our Early Access community for your feedback!



 — The Transporter Development Team

notes.title: Patch 12/11/2024 - 2 new military vehicles: Panzerwerfer and DUKW
notes.notes:
- addition of 2 military vehicles:
      * Panwerwerfer: it's a rocket launcher. It has the unique ability to fire four rockets simultaneously.
      * DUKW: both amphibious and equipped with a howitzer
 
- increase slightly air control of all vehicles

notes.title: Demo Update #3 (20240929.20.29.WD)
notes.notes:
This update adds:

- The keyboard mapping. You will find it in menu Settings -> Controls

- New trophies

notes.title: Demo Update #2 (202440916.16.38.WD)
notes.notes:
This update fixes:

- The Proto vehicle is now available for free from the start of the game. If you're having trouble starting with the Jeep Willys, the Proto will help you progress through levels more easily.

- The Omaha Beach level has been made easier. Enemy fire now causes less damage.

notes.title: Demo Update #1 (202440911.19.8.WD)
notes.notes:
This update fixes:


 The leaderboards now display 15 scores, and the ranking order has been corrected in case of tied scores.
 The replay button now allows players to instantly replay a game if they have enough credits; otherwise, they are returned to the menu.
 The wind in the "D-Day" level has been reduced by 50% to make jumps between two barges easier.
